_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN): row 34-L-solo (control). No model call. The story is imported in the sandbox group (setup off by the runner, so it auto-locks there; not measured), display.playerSetup goes on, then solo_chat opens a run-owned one-on-one chat with Arin: selecting the story is refused, no start page or player setup view appears, and neither the chat's in-memory nor its server copy (/api/chats/get) gains chat_metadata.persona or a story record. persona_auto_lock is pinned off so ST cannot lock on its own; no personas are created. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-34-solo.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" on a no-model lane.

requires.why: the solo control needs the story's character as a card; no model call

steps.eval: for (const name of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[name]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const personas = await import('/scripts/personas.js'); const pu = ctx.powerUserSettings; const record = { avatar: personas.user_avatar ?? null, autoLock: typeof pu.persona_auto_lock === 'boolean' ? pu.persona_auto_lock : null, sandboxChat: ctx.chatId ?? null }; pu.persona_auto_lock = false; sessionStorage.setItem('v2734-solo', JSON.stringify(record)); const { saveSettings } = await import('/script.js'); await saveSettings(); return record;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ playerSetup: true }); const display = rt.getGlobalSettings().display; if (display.playerSetup !== true) throw new Error('display.playerSetup did not switch on'); if (display.briefing !== false) throw new Error('display.briefing is on (the runner switches it off), so this run would not measure the briefing-off start'); const { saveSettings } = await import('/script.js'); await saveSettings(); return { playerSetup: true, briefing: false };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.groupId) throw new Error('solo_chat did not leave the group'); const before = ctx.chatMetadata.persona ?? null; const selected = await rt.selectStory('so-v2734-player-setup'); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (selected || snapshot.ready) throw new Error('the story was not refused in a one-on-one chat'); await sleep(3000); if (document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open]') || document.querySelector('#so-player-setup')) throw new Error('a one-on-one chat showed the start page'); if (rt.getSnapshot().playerSetup) throw new Error(`a one-on-one chat carries a player setup view: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().playerSetup)}`); if ((ctx.chatMetadata.persona ?? null) !== before) throw new Error(`the refused story wrote a chat lock: ${ctx.chatMetadata.persona}`); if (ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator?.stories?.['so-v2734-player-setup']) throw new Error('the refused story wrote a record into the solo chat'); const avatar = ctx.characters?.[ctx.characterId]?.avatar; const rows = await fetch('/api/chats/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ ch_name: ctx.name2, file_name: ctx.chatId, avatar_url: avatar }), cache: 'no-cache' }).then((r) => r.json()); if (!Array.isArray(rows) || !rows.length) throw new Error(`the server holds no solo chat file for ${ctx.chatId}`); const serverLock = rows[0]?.chat_metadata?.persona ?? null; if (serverLock !== before) throw new Error(`the server copy of the solo chat carries a lock: ${serverLock}`); return { refused: true, status: snapshot.status, lock: before };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const record = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('v2734-solo') ?? 'null'); if (!record) return { restored: false }; const personas = await import('/scripts/personas.js'); const pu = ctx.powerUserSettings; if (record.avatar && record.avatar in (pu.personas ?? {}) && personas.user_avatar !== record.avatar) await personas.setUserAvatar(record.avatar, { toastPersonaNameChange: false }); if (record.autoLock === null) delete pu.persona_auto_lock; else pu.persona_auto_lock = record.autoLock; const { saveSettings } = await import('/script.js'); await saveSettings(); sessionStorage.removeItem('v2734-solo'); return { restored: true, avatar: personas.user_avatar ?? null, autoLock: pu.persona_auto_lock ?? null };
